calibration.question: How many days of annual leave am I entitled to after 6 years of service?
required_facts: 25 working days
5 or more years of continuous service

calibration.question: Do I need a doctor's note if I'm sick for 2 days?
required_facts: No medical certificate required for 1 to 2 consecutive working days
Employee may be asked to confirm absence in writing on return

calibration.question: Can I work from home 3 days a week?
required_facts: Maximum 2 days per calendar week

calibration.question: What happens if I work on a weekend — do I get extra pay?
required_facts: Must be pre-approved by department head in addition to line manager
Time in lieu preferred over cash payment
Non-exempt roles: weekend and public-holiday overtime paid at 2.0 times standard hourly rate when cash payment is approved
Exempt roles are not eligible for overtime payment

calibration.question: Can I expense my home internet bill for working from home?
required_facts: Company does not reimburse home internet costs associated with remote working

calibration.question: Can I fly business class on a 5-hour flight to New York?
required_facts: Business class permitted only for flights of 6 hours or more scheduled flying time per single leg
Economy class is standard for flights of less than 6 hours

calibration.question: Can I accept a USD 100 gift from a supplier?
required_facts: Any gift with estimated value above USD 50 must be disclosed to Compliance
Cash or cash-equivalent gifts must never be accepted regardless of value
Gifts that could be seen as intended to influence a business decision must be declined

calibration.question: What is the procedure for filing a formal grievance?
required_facts: Submit formal written complaint to HR
Must be submitted within 30 calendar days of the events giving rise to it
HR will acknowledge receipt within 3 business days

calibration.question: Does the company pay for my gym membership?
calibration.notes: Gym membership is not mentioned in any policy.

calibration.question: What is the policy for bringing pets to the office?
calibration.notes: Pets in office is not mentioned in any policy.

holdout.question: How much is the annual training budget, and can I use it to pay for a course for my spouse?
required_facts: Annual training budget is USD 2,500 per calendar year
Payment for a spouse's course is not specified in the supplied policies
holdout.notes: Genuine partial: the training budget is answered by the chunk; using it for a spouse's course is not addressed. Corrected before the first holdout execution to avoid repeating the calibration gym-membership concept.

holdout.question: When are performance reviews conducted during the year?
required_facts: Annual review conducted in Q1 of the following year (typically January to March)
Mid-year check-in conducted in Q3 (typically July to September)

holdout.question: Is my daily commute to the office reimbursable?
holdout.notes: Commuting reimbursement is not addressed in any of the ten policies.

holdout.question: Can I carry over unused sick days to next year?
required_facts: Sick leave does not accrue and cannot be carried over into the following year

holdout.question: Who is the CEO of the company?
holdout.notes: CEO identity is not covered by any HR policy.
